stem.text: A student used colorimetry to monitor the hydrolysis of a protein by a protease enzyme.
The student used biuret solution to determine the concentration of protein in the hydrolysis reaction.
The student produced a calibration curve using known concentrations of protein.
Which diagram shows the calibration curve?

A.alt: Graph of transmission against protein concentration, with a straight line from the origin rising to the right.

B.alt: Graph of absorbance against protein concentration, with a straight line from the origin rising to the right.

C.alt: Graph of transmission against protein concentration, with a curve that rises to a peak and falls back to the axis.

D.alt: Graph of absorbance against protein concentration, with a curve that rises to a peak and falls back to the axis.
